in_marathi.name: Nandha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nandha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nanda’, meaning ‘joy’ or ‘bliss’. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, symbolizing his joyful nature and eternal happiness.
